description: Invoice a sales order — the order page's Generate invoice. Bills every shipped unit not yet on an invoice (a draft counts), priced as the order lines are. Leaves a draft invoice by default; issue=true also issues it (numbers it, bills the order and sends it to connected accounting), like Save and confirm. The preview lists the lines and the totals after discounts and tax. Two-step: preview=true, then commit with the previewReceipt.

clientId.description: Optional client id (GUID) for operator (unpinned) credentials on 3PL tenants.

idempotencyKey.description: Caller-generated idempotency key; required with previewReceipt to commit.

issue.description: false (default) leaves an editable draft; true also issues it (issue_invoice's effect).

preview.description: Step 1 of the required two-step write: set true to validate and receive a structured preview plus a single-use previewReceipt. Nothing is written until the commit call.

previewReceipt.description: Step 2: the receipt returned by the preview call. Supply with a fresh idempotencyKey to commit.

salesOrderId.description: Sales order id (GUID) or number from get_sales_orders.
